business_summary: Gansu Guofang Industry & Trade (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the chain retail business in China. The company operates department stores under the Dongfanghong Plaza Store, Baiyin World Trade Center Store, Ningxia Shopping Plaza Store, Zhangye Shopping Plaza Store, Xining Guofang Department Store, Guofang G99 Shopping Center, and Jinchang Guofang Department Store; supermarkets under the Zongchao Plaza Store, Zongchao Xihuayuan Store, Zongchao Qilihe Store, and Zongchao Store Gaolan store names; and electrical appliance stores under the Guofang Electric Appliances brand. It is also involved in real estate leasing business. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Lanzhou, China.

Zongchao Plaza Store, Zongchao Xihuayuan Store, Zongchao Qilihe Store 및 Zongchao Store Gaolan 매장 이름의 슈퍼마켓; Guofang Electric Appliances 브랜드의 전기제품 매장이 있습니다. 부동산 임대업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 1996년에 설립되었으며 중국 란저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
